channel.title: The Mutapa Times — Daily Zimbabwe Weather + Tsumo
channel.description: Daily weather forecast for Zimbabwe's main cities plus the Tsumo yezuva (proverb of the day). One item per day, dedicated for the Mutapa Times weather autolist.

item.title: Zim weather 14 Nov: Harare partly cloudy · high 31° / low 18°
item.description: Harare: high 31°, low 18° (partly cloudy) · Bulawayo: high 33°, low 18° (mainly clear) · Mutare: high 30°, low 18° (mainly clear) · Gweru: high 31°, low 18° (mainly clear) · Masvingo: high 32°, low 18° (mainly clear) · Victoria Falls: high 38°, low 23° (light drizzle) Tsumo yezuva: Zviro zviyedzwa.
